user.title: Balter ERA IP
user.description: Log in with a Balter ERA IP app account. A separate account for Home Assistant is recommended, otherwise the phone app may be logged out.

data_description.host: Balter cloud server. Only change this if Balter moves its server.
data_description.ring_entity: Entity that switches when the doorbell rings, e.g. a Shelly input on the indoor monitor. Can be changed later via "Configure".

error.no_devices: No door system is linked to this account.

init.title: Doorbell
init.description: Choose where doorbell rings come from. Recommended: a sensor wired to the indoor monitor, e.g. a Shelly input.

data.cloud_ring: Also listen to the Balter cloud (experimental)

data_description.ring_entity: Binary sensor, switch, input boolean (rings when it turns on) or event entity (rings on every event).
data_description.cloud_ring: Keeps a connection to the Balter cloud open and registers for push notifications. Did not deliver rings in tests.
